about.title: About
paragraphs: Full-Stack developer. Java and Spring on the back end, React and TypeScript on the front. I also wander into Computer Vision and Game Dev.
I get the most out of everything I build and help people along the way. Clear communication, real commitment, quick to learn whatever the project needs.

skills.title: Web Development
skills.description: Experience in Full-Stack development using technologies such as Java for backend, Typescript and React for frontend and many other useful tools.

skills.title: Computer Vision
skills.description: Knowledge in image processing and pattern recognition with OpenCV and Python.

skills.title: Agile Methodologies
skills.description: Experience with Scrum and Kanban for efficient project management. Use of efficient tools like Jira and Confluence.

skills.title: Game Development
skills.description: Personal projects exploring game logic and mechanics, use of tools like Unity, Allegro, and Verilog for hardware manipulation.

skills.title: Cloud Computing
skills.description: Familiarity with AWS services for scalable applications.

skills.title: Generative AI
skills.description: Experience with complex concepts of Gen AI, such as RAG, Fine-Tuning, and the different uses of APIs.

items.description: At CI&T, I applied my knowledge in a hands-on Full-Stack role, actively developing with Java (Spring Boot) on the backend and React on the frontend. I was also exposed to Node.js within a BFF architecture and honed my version control skills using Gitflow. Besides that, I got in contact with many other useful tools, such as Docker, AWS, DBeaver and Generative AI.

During my internship, I built a solid foundation in software architecture and development processes, utilizing agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and tools like Jira and SAP for documentation and change management.
